conditions: The comment brackets are the Core comment delimiters (* and *) in section 2.3.
limitations: Compiler treatment of an unmatched opening bracket is outside this claim. This record does not generalize the rule to string syntax.

triggers: Publisher revision, byte drift, a source correction, contrary technical evidence, or a material scope correction.

statement: The revised Standard ML definition permits comment brackets inside a comment when they are properly nested. The two characters of each opening or closing comment bracket must be adjacent.
